featured_reviews.name: Nelwin D'cruz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Elementaria Bakery Cafe 🍰🍷

This outlet is located right opposite of Pheonix high street, lower Parel which takes about 10 minute to get there and is easy to locate.

The ambiance of the place is very pleasing to the eyes and I totally loved it. I would say it's a perfect place for a date 😉

The staff of the place was dressed smarty in their uniform, were polite and are happy to help if you need them. The service is quick too.

The menu consist of wide variety of salads, sandwiches, waffles, slushies, coolers, puff, croissant and a hell lot of cakes 😍😍😍

What I tried?

Black Rose box (Non veg)

The plate consist of Black rice, mix lettuces, pepper, beans, sweet potato, pomegranate, beetroot and a peri peri chicken on top looked very delicious and the portion would suffice for three or four person. Would recommend if you're more into salad.

Nutty apple

A simple delightful drink that's good anytime.

Chicken Ceaser Salad (Bread sandwich) 🥙

This sandwich activated my taste buds, its a perfect combination of chicken, lettuce, herbs and grilled bread. 😍

Tokyo mojito 😍

It's fizzy, lightly sweetened, minty lime and was refreshing.

Oreo Waffle 🍫

A classic delicious waffle with a chocolatey twist. This Oreo waffle for sure will make you come here for more.

AK 47 🍸
A Crunchy chocolate shake with creme and chocolate balls on it looked visually good and tasted delicious.

Kiwi Strawberry lemonade
😍
This is the best cooler I have tried till now a perfect blend of kiwi and strawberry with lemonade. Refreshing and perfect for summer!

Overall it was a great experience! Would definitely love to try more of the menu.

Food: 4.5/5

Service: 4.5/5

Ambiance: 4.5/5

featured_reviews.name: Savio Dcunha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Elementaria Cafe and Dessert Bar is located  exactly opposite the Phoenix Tower and is small yet conveniently comfortable bakery and dessert bar. Totally drool worthy sight to see Pastries, cupcakes, cookies, croissant on the display. For all you chocolate lovers who are looking for a quick fix whilst in Lower Parel head to Elementaria which is bang opposite Lower Parel.

Value for money, variety, cafe with privacy, friendly staff are some of this Cafe & Dessert Bar's highlight. Special mention to the staff of this place who are super co-operative.

What you should try here is the the season special Cheesecake Popsicle, 48 layer Chocolate Cake, Super Thick Shakes, Croissant and a variety of Cupcakes (recommend to check with the staff).

24 layer pastry-(Recommended) it’s an extremely delicious pastry with super soft layers of chocolaty cake and accompanied with icecream and chocolate sauce.

Minty Popsicle Cheesecake - The Christmas special range of desserts..!! The warmth of the cheesecake and the freshness of Mint topped with edible color pops.!!.

Caramel Sea Salt Milkshake, AK 47 Milkshake, Eli Jumbo (A super loaded dessert with ICe Cream, Chocolate Cake, Fresh Cream, Chocolate poppers, Wafer Sticks, Strawberry Jelly - Caution this is death by sweetness and for a serving for 2 people)

Definitely a place in my bookmark and to visit again list..!!

# **A Symphony of Flavor: Daily Bread's Hot Cross Buns**
🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
**"A Taste of Tradition, Wrapped in Delight"**
**Introduction:**
In the heart of Maundy Thursday, as the world prepares for Easter, I embarked on a delightful journey with Daily Bread's Hot Cross Buns. These golden orbs, adorned with their signature cross, promised more than just sustenance—they whispered stories of tradition, warmth, and the joy of shared moments.
**Appearance:**
The buns arrived like miniature suns, their golden crusts glistening under the morning light. The cross etched into each bun stood proud, a symbol of faith and unity. As I unwrapped them, the aroma of cinnamon and nutmeg danced around me, inviting me to partake in this sacred treat.
**Texture and Taste:**
With a gentle tear, the buns revealed their tender crumb. Soft, yet resilient, they yielded to my touch. Each bite was a revelation—a symphony of flavors. The spices played their part: cinnamon hummed, nutmeg chimed, and the faint zest of orange lingered. The currants, plump and sweet, added a delightful surprise. And oh, that cross! It was more than mere decoration; it held the promise of resurrection.
**Packaging:**
The packaging was more than practical—it was an invitation to slow down, savor, and appreciate life's simple pleasures. A nod to tradition, a whisper of love.
**Conclusion:**
As I savored the last crumbs, I realized that Daily Bread's Hot Cross Buns were more than a pastry; they were a connection to centuries past. They carried the warmth of family gatherings, the sweetness of shared laughter, and the hope of renewal. So, here's to Daily Bread N Foods—for crafting not just buns, but memories.
*Unique, vibrant, and utterly delightful—these buns are a testament to the magic of tradition.*

featured_reviews.name: Akshay Wadke
featured_reviews.review_text:
Let's start with the positives :
1. Food packed and presented nicely.
2. Quantity of food is good.
3. Food quality is good.

Dishes :
1. Chicken Kheema Pattice : Honestly, one of the best I have had. Must try.
2. Chicken Berry Pulao with Dhansak : I usually don't like dhansak, but this was an exception. The dhansak was good, the kebabs were as authentic parsi as they get and the pulao was lovely too.
3. Chicken Salli boti: The sauce was absolutely spot on tangy, sweet, spicy. The chicken pieces though were dry. Also, I don't know if they forgot or they don't serve it, but there was no salli!
4. Atheli Murgi: Major disappointment.. they served something like a heavy gravy version of sweet Butter Chicken.
5. Chicken Kheema par Eedu: This was nice, layered pao, kheema and egg..
6. Lagan nu custard : Nice, but I missed the browning of the crust on top. Flavours spot on.
7. Bread pudding : Nice.

Anyways apart from the Atheli murgi, all  flavours were basically spot on. Also, they surely didn't cheap out on ingredients,  quantity or packaging (unlike so many other establishments today). And they paid attention to the small things, like the cute small paos, the little onion, tomatoes kachumber etc..
